description: The Orville's second year deepens its relationships and political entanglements as the crew faces Moclan prejudice, Krill diplomacy, first contact and the truth about Isaac's people, culminating in a conflict that reshapes the Union's place in the galaxy.

s02e01.description: A Moclan Ja'loja ceremony brings the crew together while Ed struggles with Kelly dating again, Gordon seeks John's help with his own love life, and Isaac becomes increasingly involved with Claire's family.

s02e02.description: A rescue mission brings survivors aboard while Bortus's compulsive use of a pornographic simulation begins damaging his marriage and eventually the safety of the ship.

s02e03.description: Alara returns to high-gravity Xelayah after her body begins weakening in normal gravity, confronting the family that never valued her career as the crew searches for a way to help her.

s02e04.description: Ed crash-lands behind enemy lines with a mysterious companion whose identity changes everything, while Gordon is given a difficult taste of command aboard the Orville.

s02e05.description: First contact with Regor 2 turns hostile when Kelly and Bortus are imprisoned because of their astrological birth signs, forcing the crew to challenge a legal system built around the zodiac.

s02e06.description: Claire and Isaac attempt a romantic relationship, learning how difficult intimacy is for an artificial life-form, while Bortus experiments with a moustache with predictably solemn commitment.

s02e07.description: A Moclan engineer's attraction to Talla becomes entangled with murder, exposing the brutal social consequences of Moclan prejudice beyond the official law.

s02e08.description: Isaac abruptly shuts down and the crew travels to Kaylon 1 seeking answers, where hidden evidence about the planet's former biological population reveals a catastrophic threat.

s02e09.description: With the Orville seized and a Kaylon extermination fleet headed for Earth, the surviving crew gamble on reaching the Krill and persuading an enemy to help stop a much greater one.

s02e10.description: Union peace talks with the Krill are endangered by Gordon's old friend Orrin, whose hatred of the Krill conceals a plan capable of destroying the negotiations.

s02e11.description: A twenty-first-century time capsule lets Gordon recreate the life of Laura Huggins in the simulator, and his attachment to her forces him to confront the boundary between historical record and relationship.

s02e12.description: The crew discovers a secret colony of female Moclans and a child whose existence could expose it, drawing Heveena and the Union into a confrontation over asylum and Moclan sovereignty.

s02e13.description: A temporal anomaly brings a younger Kelly Grayson aboard the Orville, forcing Ed and Kelly to revisit the beginning of their relationship and the choices that shaped both of them.

s02e14.description: A failed memory wipe creates a timeline in which the Kaylon war ended very differently, and the scattered crew must reunite long enough to restore the history they remember.
